items.title: Redefining My Relationship With You
items.summary: I no longer knew how to define my relationship with the people who read my work. Not teacher and student, not leads and customers. Here's where I eventually settled: fellow wayfarers.

items.title: Web Design Schools Have a Giant YouTube University Problem — And AI Just Made It Worse
items.summary: A web design degree used to be the obvious way to learn the craft. Now it’s competing with YouTube, AI, and people who spend those same years actually building things — so if universities can’t offer something better, students have every right to ask what they’re paying for.

items.title: Web Designers Love Dark Mode Toggles. Users Might Not Care.
items.summary: Dark mode toggles are everywhere, but do users actually need them, or are designers designing for other designers? A growing UX debate is questioning whether that little sun-and-moon button deserves permanent space in your website’s header.
